Find a Data File in the Data Tiers

Source: R/rProject-data-path.R
DataPath.Rd

Finds a data file by its plain name in the data tiers, in this order: .setup/data-raw (shareable), .setup/data-private (restricted; never public), and .setup/data-external (local only). The file can be stored as is or compressed (.xz or .gz); utils::read.table() and similar functions read compressed files directly.

Usage

DataPath(path, file, plain = FALSE)

Arguments

path

Character string. Project path.

file

Character string. Plain file name, e.g., "data.txt", even if it is stored as data.txt.xz.

plain

Logical. If TRUE, return a path to an uncompressed copy.

Value

Returns the path of the file.

Details

With plain = TRUE, a compressed file is unpacked into .setup/data-cache (local only), for tools that need plain text, such as Mplus. The copy is refreshed when the compressed file changes.
